notes: The wave that trailed behind the lyric light is gone. Letter-by-letter lyrics light only the word being sung now: the letters of that word come up in turn as the voice reaches them.
Before this, the word just sung kept its letters at half strength and the one before it at a whisper, so a run of gold travelled along the line and was still fading two words later.
That trail was the wave. It also carried across a line, so the end of a line left dimmed gold behind it, and the sheet could show two highlights moving at once instead of one light on the voice.
Every word but the one being sung goes back to the plain lyric tint on the same frame now, so there is exactly one lit word and it sits on what you are hearing.
Word-by-word and letter-by-letter are unchanged in every other way: both still follow the line timing, both still work on every song, timed or not, and both stay on when auto-scroll is off.
The nudge buttons beside Auto-scroll still shift a line that feels early or late, and the corrections you saved on your songs are untouched by this release.
